title: Server adapter layer
responsibility: Be the only door from application code into `lib/`. Each module begins with `import 'server-only'`, re-exports by explicit name or wrapper rather than `export *`, and exposes only the capabilities the shell needs; process-spawning, locking and stateful modules pass through individual review before they are exposed at all.
notes: ⚠️ PLANNED, NOT BUILT (2026-08-27). `implementedBy` is absent, and its absence is the only signal in this artifact that says so — the same convention CMP-0011 established, and the same hazard QST-0015 named: creating these records takes the orphan count to zero while nothing exists. 'Every requirement traces to a component' becomes true; 'the shell works' does not. ⚠️ THE GUARD CANNOT LIVE IN `lib/`, which is why this component exists rather than a one-line edit. AST-0033 measured that `server-only` throws when imported outside the RSC compiler, and `lib/` is imported by every `bin/` command and the whole test suite — marking it would guard the application by breaking the tool. ⚠️ IT PREVENTS NOTHING THE BUILD DID NOT ALREADY PREVENT. Both client-import cases already fail; what the marker buys is a LOCATABLE failure. Unguarded, Turbopack reports an internal error with `location: undefined` and no filename (AST-0032). ⚠️ OUTSIDE ITS BOUNDARY: it holds no logic of its own. A wrapper that adapts a signature is permitted; a wrapper that decides anything belongs in `lib/`, where the tool and the app share it.
